name: Modwing
ability: Cloud Chaser / Motor Drive / Gale Wings (hidden)
look: a boxy gunmetal box-mod bird with a glowing face panel, battery cells on its flanks, an airflow ring and a drip-tip beak
entry: Bulkier and boxier than Vapulon, Modwing sports dual battery cells on its flanks and an adjustable airflow ring around its neck that whistles when it dives.
how: Evolve Vapulon at level 25. It learns Twin-Coil Surge when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Evolves into Subohmega when a Thunder Stone is used on it.
